people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.
translations.bsb: “Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
translations.kjv: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues
translations.asv: And Edom shall become an astonishment: every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
